purpose: Make the two platform-dependent text decodings in the original provider run explicit and reproducible
transform: Encode the stored Unicode text as UTF-8 bytes, then decode those bytes as Windows-1252 before prompt construction
scope: The transform preserves the exact text sent in the reported run. It affects punctuation encoding in two ADRs and does not truncate either document.
analysis_note: The manuscript evidence includes a 160-ADR exclusion check for these two records. No provider responses were regenerated.
